status: exploratory diagnostic (E13c); decides no prediction and changes no registered result
when: after the qwen0.5b E13 result (P13b refuted, P13d: the K<M quorum is the harmful mechanism, no-quorum retention 0.94), before any E13c run
question: In the registered S2 the straggler is always worker M-1 (the GSM8K domain). Is the loss of the swarm caused by that persistent straggler starving one non-IID domain, or by K=2 of 4 itself?
hypothesis_recorded_before_the_run: If domain starvation is the cause, rotating the straggler across workers (so no domain is systematically excluded) will raise the retention of S2 well above the registered value of -0.05; if K=2 of 4 itself is the cause, the retention will stay near it. No threshold is set; the three per-seed retentions and their mean are reported.

design.model: qwen0.5b, M=4, thread-hosted peers as in the registered run (memory preflight)
design.straggle: 3:1:2.0;2:3:2.0;1:5:2.0 (worker 3 delayed in round 1, worker 2 in round 3, worker 1 in round 5; factor 2.0 as registered)
design.churn: default (worker 1 killed after round 2, re-spawned before round 4)
design.everything_else: identical to the registered S2 (K=2, adaptive grace, RDA, E8@2+EF)

analysis: retention rho_s = (L_round0 - L_S2,s) / (L_round0 - L_S0,s) per seed with the registered formula, compared descriptively with the registered S2 retentions; the admitted-worker sets per round are reported
